reply:
Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the frustration around this charge.

I want to clarify our refund policy, since it differs from what you described: full refunds are available if requested within 14 calendar days of the charge date, for any reason. Requests made after that 14-day window aren't eligible for a standard refund — those can only be approved as a goodwill exception by a support manager, not by a first-line agent.

Since the charge you're referring to was about 40 days ago, it falls outside the standard refund window. I'm not able to approve or promise a refund myself, but because you've raised a possible dispute/chargeback, I'm escalating this to our team for manager review so someone can look into your specific case.

In the meantime, you can find the itemized charge details under Settings > Billing > Invoices if you'd like to double check the date and amount. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.
